title: After 20 years, scientists finally explain the Crab Pulsar’s strange “zebra stripes”
summary: For decades, astronomers have been puzzled by strange “zebra stripe” patterns in radio waves from the Crab Pulsar — bright bands separated by complete darkness. Now, new research suggests the answer lies in a cosmic tug-of-war between gravity and plasma.
